text:
Sam H: Hey team — can someone take a quick look at the 3-way bakeoff runbook? planning to run H100 / A100 / L40S overnight to surface slot-level congestion and kernel fallbacks. need infra + perf owners.
Kevin L: I can own infra. what driver/kernel are we aligning on? also want DCGM + nvlink counters on.
Maria G: I can do perf analysis. will collect NCU traces + topdown perf events. can we pin host CPUs and disable irqbalance for the runs? small config note: isolate CPUs for the bench pods.
Olga P: I’ll prepare the bench-runner jobs in prow. which models + batch/seq combos do we want? do we want staggered start times to avoid thermal coupling?
Sam H: good q. target models: redwood/llama-70b (fp16), open-l2-7b, and a small conv-decoder test. batch sizes: 1, 4, 16. seq lengths: 512, 2048, 8192 (longctx). target metrics: p50/p95/p99 token latency, steady-state throughput 5min window, GPU utl, and kernel fallback counts. stagger by 30m between SKUs to ease power draw.
Kevin L: driver: nvidia-driver 535.54 + kernel 6.1. dcgm 2.4.1. I’ll enable telemetry: gpu_util, sm_efficiency, nvlink_tx, nvlink_rx, and power_draw. I’ll also set host interval to 5s.
Maria G: data collection checklist (put into runbook):
```
- ncu --target-processes all --trace cdp --sample 10s -o /tmp/ncu_$SKU
- dcgmi stats --export /s3/bench/$TEST_ID/dcgm.json
- node exporter + perf counters: cpu, irq, interrupts, dram_read_transactions
- collect dmesg + kernel logs
```
Also we should capture /proc/interrupts before/after and nv_peer_memory errors.
Olga P: created bench job templates. will add a param for STAGGER_MINUTES. I’ll push a PR shortly. job names will be bench-3way-$SKU-$RUNNUM.
devops-bot: Scheduled job created -> bench-3way-H100-001 (starts 2312354078), bench-3way-A100-001 (starts 2312355878), bench-3way-L40S-001 (starts 2312357678).
Kevin L: one more: please enable thermal threshold alerts. I’ll set a soft power cap for the first run and remove for the second to see perf delta. also ensure we have swap disabled on nodes used.
Sam H: Maria, can you own the post-run analysis? bucket path will be s3://redwood-bench/3way/2312345678/. collect perf artifacts + a short writeup with top 3 regressions.
Maria G: yep. will run quick regression diffs and a p99 delta table. I’ll also look for kernel fallback stacks and attach flamegraphs.
Olga P: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/bench-runner/pull/482 — includes job templates + STAGGER_MINUTES var.
Sam H: perfect. Kevin, Maria, Olga — thanks. I’ll kick off the first run tonight after 20:00 PT. please ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
